The '''Blue Sector''' was a section of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] with a reputation as a dangerous part of town. [[Treasure Ship Row/Legends|Treasure Ship Row]] was located there. Despite its reputation as Corellia's most dangerous area, given the high crime rate, it was where most offworlders tended to visit. Its name derived from [[Blue Sky Boulevard]], the main road leading into it from downtown. Blue Sector was dotted with [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] parlors, fences, casinos, [[flophouse]]s, brothels, and pawn shops. A large junkyard on the outskirts of Blue Sector was referred to by the locals as [[Coronet City Waste Disposal Center|The Pit]] where it was rumored that "organic drop-offs" were buried alongside metal scrap and chemical waste.
